acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a valid icons.json, produces the correct number of IconDefinition instances.
Icons are sorted alphabetically by ID.
The spinner icon is excluded from the result set.

summary: Created src/classes/Application/Composer/IconBuilder/IconsReader.php in the Application\\Composer\\IconBuilder namespace. Constructor takes the JSON file path. getIcons() lazy-loads and caches the parsed icons: uses JSONFile::factory() to read the JSON, normalises IDs (hyphens/spaces to underscores), excludes the spinner icon via the EXCLUDED_ICON_SPINNER constant, creates IconDefinition instances, sorts by ID via ksort(), and returns array_values(). Also provides countIcons() convenience method and getPath() accessor. PHPStan clean — only pre-existing DBHelper error present. composer dump-autoload completed.

comments.note: No observations — IconsReader is a clean, minimal parser class. The lazy-load pattern (icons loaded on first getIcons() call, cached thereafter) is appropriate. Spinner exclusion is defined as a named constant (EXCLUDED_ICON_SPINNER) rather than a magic string, which is good practice.

summary: All 4 ACs verified by live execution against the actual icons.json (213 icons = 214 raw minus spinner). ID normalization confirmed (time_tracker from time-tracker). Alphabetical sort confirmed. Spinner excluded. Edge cases: missing file returns empty array, lazy-load caches on first call. No regressions in existing icon tests.

Edge case: when the JSON file path does not exist, getIcons() returns an empty array (graceful fallback via file->exists() check). This is correct behavior, consistent with the optional-file pattern used elsewhere.
Lazy-load caching verified: $this->icons is populated on first getIcons() call and cached thereafter. Second call returns the identical array.

summary: Code review PASS. IconsReader.php is clean, well-structured, and follows all project conventions. Lazy-load caching, typed constant, graceful missing-file handling, and alphabetical sort are all correctly implemented. All 4 ACs confirmed met by QA. No Fix-Forward changes needed.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent. IconsReader is a minimal, well-scoped parser. The lazy-load pattern (?array $icons = null → populated on first getIcons() call) is appropriate and idiomatic. EXCLUDED_ICON_SPINNER is a typed const string, which is correct. The file-missing fallback (returns empty array) is correct for a tool-time reader.

IconsReader::normaliseID() is identical to IconCollection::normaliseID(). Both classes independently implement str_replace(array('-',' '), '_', $id). At two sites this is acceptable (extracting a shared utility would add coupling between unrelated namespaces), but if a third site appears a shared IconIDNormaliser utility or a dedicated trait would be warranted. Low-priority architectural note for future reference.
